PurposeFounder and management control board for customer credit posture, release permission, promise-to-pay reliability, trust-linked holds, outgoing cash discipline, and founder override readiness.
Source ruleUpdate collections, customer account review, strategic trust review, trust posture matrix, response escalation, cash forecast, capital allocation, funding release, active deal, shipment release, and customer source records first, then refresh this board.
Decision ruleDo not widen release, shipment acceleration, supplier funding, proforma confidence, or account growth unless payment proof, trust tier, collection timing, and live release gates support the same answer.
